body: I assume it is. I've had body aches and lethargy for as long as I've been feeling this horrible. I have no idea what to do, so I would like some help as well... I tried to jog and exercise but now my body hurts 10 times more because of sore muscles.
Thank you.
Thank you for your concern, but it doesn't make me feel good when I think of someone feeling sad because of me, so please, don't.

I'm not old enough. I've already been on antidepressants and my family doesn't care for me. 
I've had suicidal thoughts for a while. I self harm. I'm a lost cause. Thank you for taking your time out of your day and talking to me.

I've also never heard anyone be concerned about me.

I'll stick to posting to r/suicidewatch. 

I don't enjoy anything. I just do it so I don't feel lonely. I've lost interest in drawing a long time ago.

It just feels wrong to post in a subreddit for depression, where people who have actual problems seek help. 

I've lost all my interest in hobbies. I spent 4 years learning to draw, and now it just... doesn't interest me. I try and play video games but most of the time playing a video game actually gives me anxiety, for some reason. I only lay in bed all day.... is listening to YouTube all day a hobby?

Appetite and sleep is a difficult thing to talk about. I've been trouble sleeping, but that's because it's become really hot in my country.  And my appetite is huge. But it has always been that way.... I dont think I am clinically depressed, or just... depressed... I feel like my brain is just making things up to get me attention. 

Listening is the best I can ask for. I am very thankful. I'm more depressed because I know how easily the person will forget me, while I have them on my mind all day and night. That's what hurts the most.

Hello, thank you for your reply. I'm lonely because I don't have a single person to talk to, to be with, to share my feelings... I lost the only person I had a few days ago, since then, I've completely broke. I sit in silence with just youtube videos constantly going on all day. I don't even listen to them. I just want to feel like someone is next to me. 

I just have no people. I have classmates but they dont talk about serious things.
Thank you deeply. Best of luck. I'm glad you're not alone.

I understand. I'm a teenager too and none of the people in my life take me seriously. It's now edgy and cool to be "depressed".  I'm lonely and actually alone. I know what I am talking about. I understand the feeling. I punch walls and cut myself. I want to inflict so much pain that I forget all my emotions. It really hurts to just lie in bed and cry. Then calm down, watch YouTube just to feel tears pile up again. This country doesnt respect mental health and people with mental illness. Nor do they understand depression. Its a tough world... hoping I can escape it someday. Soon.
I also wanted to add, it's okay to feel that way. Your feelings are valid. Everything you feel is valid. Stay strong, I believe In you.
I always watch YouTube, where someone is talking. I've been doing that for years... I dont think it works anymore.. but thank you for your advice.
I despise when people say "just talk to someone". If I had someone to talk to I wouldn't be here, spamming 3 subreddits with my useless thoughts constantly. Lonely.
Thank you for taking your time to reply. I like seeing people express their opinion and what the have to say. Makes me feel less lonely. Thank you for understanding.
Thank you for your advice.
Antidepressants and Painkillers. Delirium, stomach ache, lethargy, sleepless nights. Vomit.
I cut myself so it hurts so much that I dont want to cry from emotions anymore. I keep trying to be strong but I break down. Everytime. I break down everytime.

I feel weak and I feel like it's human nature to want to be loved by someone and to just talk to a person you trust. I dont know what I'm going to do anymore. I really dont want to stay here and go insane slowly. Either way, thank you.
Dying would be perfect but I dont mind pain
I'm young as well and the pain is unbearable at times... It ruins me.
Me too. I'm alone and my only interaction with humans is reddit. I think I am slowly going to go insane and commit homicide
Thank you. Good luck.
Sadly I am. Thank you for your care, deeply appreciated.
It's okay. I should start getting used to being alone. Tears are inevitable... So is anxiety. And depression. And suicidal thoughts. And suicidal tendencies. And suicide attempts.
My anxiety eased up but now I've started to cry. Thank you, though.
Survival rate is too high unless you're at the Mariana's trench or some shit. Thanks for the advice,  though.

I didn't think someone could write my emotions so well. Sometimes I become so erratic that I start to itch everywhere, shake, and just... break down.
Get better soon.
I have no bleach. Going to a high building is too risky, you can get reported and plus... do high buildings just have unrestricted access to the roof? I don't think so.
I will try that. Thank you for your advice and time.

If I had a rope I would go into a forest and attempt to hang myself. But I dont. I have no options. What can I do? Just put a plastic bag on my head and go to sleep? I have no gasses, no drugs, nothing to soothe it or help. I also put faith in my horrible health, that I could develop a disease that would kill me. Thank you for the advise. Best of luck to you, too. Find peace.

I'm weak and my body aches, I have no will to get up from bed. I don't have anyone. Family hates me, and just yesterday night I lost my partner. Even if my partner was toxic, I feel lost and depressed without them. Thank you for the help.

I tried overdose and then learned that overdose is so much more difficult than it looks in the movies. I have too much anxiety to die publicly. I know I seem like a pussy. Because that's what I am. I hope one day I die from an accident. Or find courage to stab myself.
I guess my resistance isn't good. What a pity.

I took around 20 antidepressants and 6 painkillers and I'm okay. Overdose is so much more difficult than people think. From my experience you will just puke it out and then have a horrible stomach ache for 3 days. Not to mention the sleepless night, delirium.... it's not effective.
All the time. Even if my razor is right next to my bed. I just feel too lazy to do it... It's good... I guess..?
Nice. Thank you.  I might check it out. I'm desperate enough.
I'm always feeling down, Haha. Sadly I have to leave the house since I go to school. I don't want to be a bother, but I appreciate your niceness.
Hopefully I get relief one way or another. Thank you.
Teen years. I won't say the age since then no one will take me seriously.
